message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: The defendant performed medical diagnosis/treatment without a medical license (no doctor qualification). This is illegal medical practice. In examples, similar case: first example about 廖某某 operating a dental clinic without qualification => answer: 非法行医 (illegal practice of medicine). So here also illegal medical practice. Possibly also illegal possession of medical devices? But main crime is illegal medical practice. The list of items seized includes injection solutions etc. The crime is "非法行医". In Chinese criminal law, the offense is "非法行医罪". So answer: [罪名]非法行医<eoa>
